title.narrative: Facilitated inclusive parliamentary processes, addressing socioeconomic issues (i.e. poverty, hunger, health, education)

description.narrative: Progress has been achieved for this result through the following interventions: 1.Action Plans on women property rights and women trafficking were developed by WPC Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. The purpose of these action plans was to address key issues, generating policy recommendations, and fostering collaboration among Members of the Women Parliamentary Caucus (WPC), Provincial Assembly of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. These results lay the groundwork for evidencebased interventions and legislative reforms aimed at improving womens inheritance rights and combat women trafficking in Pakistan and particularly in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.The Womens Parliamentary Caucus in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa has also formulated a detailed plan of action, outlining their strategic objectives, activities, and targets to address genderrelated issues and promote womens empowerment within the province. The completion of the WPC Action Planning for Khyber Pakhtunkhwa signifies a significant milestone in promoting gender equality and womens empowerment in the province. It showcases the dedication of the Womens Parliamentary Caucus and other stakeholders towards addressing genderrelated issues through evidencebased policy interventions and effective legislative actions. Continuous monitoring and evaluation will be essential to ensure the successful implementation of the action plan and the realization of its intended impact.2.Conference on Road Safety: A conference on road safety was organized as a public outreach event, engaging civil society organizations (CSOs) and other stakeholders. The conference provided a platform for discussions, raising awareness, and exchanging ideas on road safety issues. It facilitated collaboration, knowledgesharing, and the integration of diverse perspectives into legislative considerations and policy formulation processes. The establishment of mechanisms for sustained engagement between parliamentarians and stakeholders promotes inclusive governance and effective policy outcomes.The achievement of this progress against the results indicators demonstrates progress in facilitating inclusive parliamentary processes that address socioeconomic issues, promote gender equality, womens empowerment, and ensure the participation of diverse stakeholders.

These results lay the groundwork for evidencebased interventions and legislative reforms aimed at improving womens inheritance rights and combat women trafficking in Pakistan and particularly in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.The Womens Parliamentary Caucus in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa has also formulated a detailed plan of action, outlining their strategic objectives, activities, and targets to address genderrelated issues and promote womens empowerment within the province. The completion of the WPC Action Planning for Khyber Pakhtunkhwa signifies a significant milestone in promoting gender equality and womens empowerment in the province. It showcases the dedication of the Womens Parliamentary Caucus and other stakeholders towards addressing genderrelated issues through evidencebased policy interventions and effective legislative actions. Continuous monitoring and evaluation will be essential to ensure the successful implementation of the action plan and the realization of its intended impact.2.Conference on Road Safety: A conference on road safety was organized as a public outreach event, engaging civil society organizations (CSOs) and other stakeholders. The conference provided a platform for discussions, raising awareness, and exchanging ideas on road safety issues. It facilitated collaboration, knowledgesharing, and the integration of diverse perspectives into legislative considerations and policy formulation processes. The establishment of mechanisms for sustained engagement between parliamentarians and stakeholders promotes inclusive governance and effective policy outcomes.The achievement of this progress against the results indicators demonstrates progress in facilitating inclusive parliamentary processes that address socioeconomic issues, promote gender equality, womens empowerment, and ensure the participation of diverse stakeholders.

comment.narrative: 1.NA zero 2020Senate zero 2020KPK zero 2020Punjab zero 2020Sindh zero 2020Balochistan zero 2020
1.NA 50 Senate 50KPK 50Punjab 50Sindh 50Balochistan 50

The predicament with adding values to this indicator is that its baseline is set at Zero and when taking percentages it yields a zero result. In case the baseline is taken at 1 the value achieved is extremely inflated and unrealistic like in the Outcome 1.7 and Output 1.3 etc. This is indeed a logframing issue but the general increase in participation of the parliamentarians is significantly more than 50 of the baseline value.

title.narrative: Strengthened capacity for administration and support services

description.narrative: The progress achieved for the result includes the following:Training of Senate Staff on Pre/Post Legislative Scrutiny: The successful training program enhanced the capacities of 27 Senate members in parliamentary processes and businesses. Practical legislative drafting skills were emphasized through case studies and interactive discussions. The program contributed to the efficiency, transparency, accountability, and good governance of the assembly. The genderdisaggregated participation of 21 men and 6 women promoted inclusivity and equal access.Development of Gender Toolkit: A gender toolkit was developed to support gender mainstreaming efforts, genderresponsive budgeting, and related initiatives. The toolkit served as a resource for senators and facilitated the incorporation of a gender perspective into legislative processes. Twentyseven members from the Senate participated in the gender sensitization workshop, including 21 men and 6 women, enhancing their understanding and awareness of genderrelated issues.Capacity Building for Parliamentary Secretariats: Workshops were conducted to enhance the technical capacities of parliamentary secretariats. The workshops focused on the responsibilities and functions of assembly officers in connection with House and Committee business. Participants gained a comprehensive understanding of assembly operations, procedures, and protocols. This targeted effort aimed to improve the knowledge and skills of officers working within parliamentary secretariats. A total of 88 assembly officers attended the workshops, including 85 men and 3 women.These achievements demonstrate progress in strengthening the capacity for administration and support services within the assembly. The training programs, development of a gender toolkit, and capacity building for parliamentary secretariats have collectively enhanced the efficiency, effectiveness, and gender sensitivity of the administration and support functions.

National Assembly and Senate1.Senior Human Rights Expert2.Senior Legislative Drafting Expert3.Senior Gender and CrossParty Forum Expert4.Senior Local Coordination and Quality Assurance IT Expert5.Senior Legislative and NonLegislative Expert6.Senior PFM Expert7.Senior Communications Expert8.Junior Communications Expert9.Senior Economics ExpertProvincial Assemblies1.Punjab and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa AssembliesoStrategic Planning Technical Expert Recruited to review the level of implementation of their plans and develop a workplan for their existing Strategic Plans.2.Sindh and Balochistan AssembliesoStrategic Planning Technical Expert Recruited to develop Strategic Plans for the Provincial Assemblies of Sindh and Balochistan

title.narrative: Strengthened capacity for administration and support services

description.narrative: The progress achieved for the result includes the following:Training of Senate Staff on Pre/Post Legislative Scrutiny: The successful training program enhanced the capacities of 27 Senate members in parliamentary processes and businesses. Practical legislative drafting skills were emphasized through case studies and interactive discussions. The program contributed to the efficiency, transparency, accountability, and good governance of the assembly. The genderdisaggregated participation of 21 men and 6 women promoted inclusivity and equal access.Development of Gender Toolkit: A gender toolkit was developed to support gender mainstreaming efforts, genderresponsive budgeting, and related initiatives. The toolkit served as a resource for senators and facilitated the incorporation of a gender perspective into legislative processes. Twentyseven members from the Senate participated in the gender sensitization workshop, including 21 men and 6 women, enhancing their understanding and awareness of genderrelated issues.Capacity Building for Parliamentary Secretariats: Workshops were conducted to enhance the technical capacities of parliamentary secretariats. The workshops focused on the responsibilities and functions of assembly officers in connection with House and Committee business. Participants gained a comprehensive understanding of assembly operations, procedures, and protocols. This targeted effort aimed to improve the knowledge and skills of officers working within parliamentary secretariats. A total of 88 assembly officers attended the workshops, including 85 men and 3 women.These achievements demonstrate progress in strengthening the capacity for administration and support services within the assembly. The training programs, development of a gender toolkit, and capacity building for parliamentary secretariats have collectively enhanced the efficiency, effectiveness, and gender sensitivity of the administration and support functions.

description.narrative: The project has made significant progress in achieving the result. The following key points summarize the progress:1.Development of Strategic Plans: Two strategic plans have been developed/revised, including the Strategic Plan Implementation Strategy for Punjab Assembly and the 1st draft of the Balochistan Strategic Plan. These plans have enhanced the capacity for budgetary oversight and representation within the respective assemblies, providing a roadmap for effective governance and aligning assembly goals with constituents needs.2.Policy Dialogue and Participation: A policy dialogue was conducted, with the attendance of 126 parliamentarians from different houses. This inclusive dialogue increased understanding of budgetrelated matters, the state of the economy, and Pakistans debt challenges among participants. The dialogue fostered more informed decisionmaking, improving budgetary allocations and economic planning.3.Beneficiary Briefings and Legislative Acts: Beneficiaries were briefed on social issues and relevant laws, including Women Inheritance Law, Hindu Marriage Act, and Human Trafficking Act. The project supported legislative acts that provided legal protection, addressed gender equality, religious minority rights, and human trafficking. The drafting of Acts in all houses is an ongoing process, contributing to meeting international obligations.4.Improved Parliamentary Processes: The project enhanced the effectiveness of parliamentary processes and representation of diverse perspectives. Parliamentarians knowledge and skills were improved in areas such as legislative assessment, postlegislative scrutiny, delegated legislation, and representation. This progress aligned legislative drafting practices with international best practices, promoting transparency, accountability, and inclusivity.5.National Conference on SDGs: The national conference on Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) served as a platform for interassembly exchanges and discussions. Representatives from all assemblies and diverse stakeholders participated, promoting collaboration, shared learning, and addressing national and provincial priorities.6.Capacity Building for Stakeholder Engagement: Activities and workshops enhanced parliamentarians capacity to engage with media, civil society organizations (CSOs), and other stakeholders. Parliamentarians actively participated, improving their communication skills, transparency, and partnerships. Womens representation in these initiatives reflected the commitment to gender equality and active participation in legislative processes.7.Gender Analysis Toolkit: A Gender Analysis Toolkit was developed and piloted to improve the capacity of parliamentary committees and women parliamentary caucuses in addressing genderrelated concerns. The toolkit provided practical guidance for conducting gender analysis, promoting gender mainstreaming, and integrating a gender lens into policy development and legislative processes. It contributed to addressing gender, inclusiveness, and minority rights in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Punjab, and Sindh Provincial Assemblies.The progress made in these areas collectively contributed to the enhanced legislative, oversight, budgetary, and representation capacity, promoting effective governance, transparency, accountability, inclusivity, gender equality, and human rights in the legislative process.
